name: valuz-dsh-bundle
description: The Valuz layer over the upstream DeepSeek Harness distribution, shipped as a standard dsh bundle (dsh.bundle.patch). It selects each process's role on one shared profile (VALUZ_DSH_ROLE=session: the SDK JSON-RPC child of a kernel session; manager: the resident web host that manages plugins the dsh way), switches off every row that ships data to the model vendor, and mounts the Valuz plugins: session-preset (joins SDK-created agents to the profile's agent preset), stream-forwarder (live model stream frames → kernel) and kernel-bridge (plan state, user questions, tool approvals, Valuz instructions). Its peer dependency pins the exact dsh release it was written against; scripts/dsh-upstream-sync.sh moves both together.
